payload.title: The /farms Socket.IO gateway admits any token carrying a tenantId and emits all 41 farm domain events (batches, mortality, feeding, meals, stock, sites, tanks) to one tenant-wide room, so every connected tenant member receives farm-private data whatever their module
evidence: apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/farm.gateway.ts:143-149 (the handshake requires only a token carrying tenantId)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/farm.gateway.ts:232 (every farm event is emitted to that room)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/farm-nats-bridge.service.ts:378-386 (MortalityRecorded and FeedingRecorded are forwarded as whole events)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/websocket.module.ts:55-56 (socket revalidation checks only the token blacklist and user epoch, never access)
payload.rule_violated: D2: farm-private data reaches only holders of a farm grant, on every surface including realtime pushes.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-10, release R4.
